headers.name: actual_canonical_distinct_receiver
headers.header:
theorem actual_canonical_distinct_receiver
    (face : TaxonOuterFace D N.leaf)
    (hnt : ∃ u v : BlobVertex N.graph b, u≠v) :
    ∃ (n mask : Nat) (rank : N.BlobPort b ≃ Fin n)
      (C : Set Plane) (f : ℝ → Plane) (θ : (M).OpenedTip → ℝ)
      (xs : List (M).OpenedTip) (k : Nat) (T : Tree),
      2≤n ∧ mask<2^n ∧ IsJordanCurve C ∧
      Graph.face (graph (blobCurves D b)) (curve (blobCurves D b))
        (coordinates face.outside)=outside C ∧
      IsLoop f ∧ f '' unitInterval=C ∧
      (∀ t, θ t∈Ico (0:ℝ) 1 ∧ f (θ t)=tipPoint N D b hg hb t) ∧
      Function.Injective θ ∧ xs.Nodup ∧ (∀ t, t∈xs) ∧
      xs.Pairwise (fun a c => θ a≤θ c) ∧ k≤1 ∧
      (xs.rotate k).map (fun t => (rank ((M).openedTipLabel hl t)).val)=occurrenceLabels n mask ∧
      T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1 ∧
      (∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ N.BlobPort b,
        (M).rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
          ⟨(rank (q 0)).val,(rank (q 1)).val,(rank (q 2)).val,(rank (q 3)).val⟩ ∧
        (M).rawQuartetMean q=Nanuq.Quartet.distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
          ⟨(rank (q 0)).val,(rank (q 1)).val,(rank (q 2)).val,(rank (q 3)).val⟩)) ∧
      (∀ (q : Fin 4 ↪ X) (hinj : Function.Injective (fun i => N.blobProjection b hb (q i))),
        N.rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
          ⟨(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 0))).val,(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 1))).val,
           (rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 2))).val,(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 3))).val⟩ ∧
        N.rawQuartetMean q=Nanuq.Quartet.distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
          ⟨(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 0))).val,(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 1))).val,
           (rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 2))).val,(rank (N.blobProjection b hb (q 3))).val⟩))

headers.name: mem_finiteResolutionSet
headers.header:
theorem mem_finiteResolutionSet (T : Tree) (tips : List Nat) (Q : Quartet) (r : Resolution) :
    r∈finiteResolutionSet T tips Q ↔
      ∃ e∈T.internalIntervals 1, edgeWitness tips e.1 e.2 Q (resolutionIndex r)=true

headers.name: finiteResolutionSet_code
headers.header:
theorem finiteResolutionSet_code (T : Tree) (tips : List Nat) (qs : List Quartet)
    (idx : Nat) (Q : Quartet) (hQ : qs[idx]?=some Q) (r : Resolution) :
    r∈finiteResolutionSet T tips Q ↔
      (Nanuq.AdjacentCertificate.code (T.summary (edgeContribution tips qs) 1) idx).testBit
        (resolutionIndex r)=true

headers.name: actual_distinct_set_and_mean_finite
headers.header:
theorem actual_distinct_set_and_mean_finite
    (code : X ↪ Nat) (lab : N.OpenedHybridVertex → Nat) (T : Tree) (tips : List Nat)
    (hlab : ∀ t, lab (N.openedTipVertex t)=code (N.openedTipLabel hl t))
    (hfinite : ∀ (Q : Quartet) (r a b c d : Nat), Q.parts r=(a,b,c,d) → a≠b → c≠d →
      (LabelledQuartet (N.openedHybridGraph hl) lab a b c d ↔
        ∃ e∈T.internalIntervals 1, edgeWitness tips e.1 e.2 Q r=true))
    (q : Fin 4 ↪ X) :
    N.rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T tips
      ⟨code (q 0),code (q 1),code (q 2),code (q 3)⟩ ∧
    N.rawQuartetMean q=distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T tips
      ⟨code (q 0),code (q 1),code (q 2),code (q 3)⟩)

headers.name: actual_occurrence_selection_extends
headers.header:
theorem actual_occurrence_selection_extends
    (q : I ↪ X) (t : I → N.OpenedTip)
    (ht : ∀ i, N.openedTipLabel hleaf (t i)=q i) :
    ∃ C : N.HybridParentChoice, ∀ i, C.selectedTipEmbedding hleaf (q i)=t i

headers.name: actual_displayed_iff_occurrence_resolves
headers.header:
theorem actual_displayed_iff_occurrence_resolves (q : Fin 4 ↪ X) (r : Resolution) :
    r∈N.rawDisplayedQuartets q ↔
      ∃ t : Fin 4 ↪ N.OpenedTip,
        (∀ i, N.openedTipLabel hleaf (t i)=q i) ∧
        (N.openedHybridGraph hleaf).Resolves (fun i => N.openedTipVertex (t i)) r

headers.name: actual_block_support
headers.header:
theorem actual_block_support (code : X ↪ Nat) (label : O → X)
    (surj : Function.Surjective label) (xs : List O) (hall : ∀ t, t∈xs)
    (k : Nat) (base : List Nat) (dup : Nat → Bool)
    (hblocks : (xs.rotate k).map (fun t => code (label t))=blocks base dup) :
    ∀ z, z∈base ↔ ∃ x, code x=z

headers.name: exists_canonical_port_rank
headers.header:
theorem exists_canonical_port_rank (code : X ↪ Nat) (base : List Nat)
    (hnd : base.Nodup) (support : ∀ z, z∈base ↔ ∃ x, code x=z) :
    ∃ rank : X ≃ Fin base.length, ∀ x, (rank x).val=base.idxOf (code x)

headers.name: canonical_syntax_receiver
headers.header:
theorem canonical_syntax_receiver (G : EdgeGraph V E) (tip : O ↪ V)
    (tipLabel : O → X) (code : X ↪ Nat) (xs : List O) (k : Nat) (base : List Nat)
    (dup : Nat → Bool) (s : BinarySyntax V) (oldLab : V → Nat)
    (hfront : s.frontier=xs.map tip) (hs : 2≤xs.length) (hk : k≤1) (hbase : base.Nodup)
    (hblocks : (xs.rotate k).map (fun t => code (tipLabel t))=blocks base dup)
    (hold : ∀ t, oldLab (tip t)=code (tipLabel t))
    (hsource : ∀ (lab : V → Nat) a b c d,
      LabelledQuartet G lab a b c d ↔ (encode lab s).Witness [] a b c d)
    (rank : X ≃ Fin base.length) (hrank : ∀ x, (rank x).val=base.idxOf (code x)) :
    ∃ (lab : V → Nat) (T : Tree),
      (∀ t, lab (tip t)=(rank (tipLabel t)).val) ∧
      T.size=(occurrenceLabels base.length (restrictedMask base dup)).length-1 ∧
      (∀ (q : Quartet) (r a b c d : Nat), q.parts r=(a,b,c,d) → a≠b → c≠d →
        (LabelledQuartet G lab a b c d ↔
          ∃ e∈T.internalIntervals 1,
            edgeWitness (occurrenceLabels base.length (restrictedMask base dup)) e.1 e.2 q r=true))

headers.name: labelled_quartet_iff_tip_witness
headers.header:
theorem labelled_quartet_iff_tip_witness (a b c d : X) :
    LabelledQuartet (N.openedHybridGraph hl) lab (code a) (code b) (code c) (code d) ↔
      ∃ w x y z : N.OpenedTip,
        (N.openedTipLabel hl w=a ∧ N.openedTipLabel hl x=b ∧
          N.openedTipLabel hl y=c ∧ N.openedTipLabel hl z=d) ∧
        (N.openedHybridGraph hl).HasQuartet (N.openedTipVertex w) (N.openedTipVertex x)
          (N.openedTipVertex y) (N.openedTipVertex z)

headers.name: actual_displayed_iff_labelled
headers.header:
theorem actual_displayed_iff_labelled (q : Fin 4 ↪ X) (r : Resolution) :
    r∈N.rawDisplayedQuartets q ↔
      match r with
      | .xy_zw => LabelledQuartet (N.openedHybridGraph hl) lab (code (q 0)) (code (q 1)) (code (q 2)) (code (q 3))
      | .xz_yw => LabelledQuartet (N.openedHybridGraph hl) lab (code (q 0)) (code (q 2)) (code (q 1)) (code (q 3))
      | .xw_yz => LabelledQuartet (N.openedHybridGraph hl) lab (code (q 0)) (code (q 3)) (code (q 1)) (code (q 2))
